entities.summary: Emily Weiss is an American businesswoman. She is the founder and former CEO of the cosmetics company Glossier and the blog Into the Gloss. She was featured in a Forbes 30 Under 30 list in 2015. In 2019, she was included in Time magazine's "Next 100". In May 2022, she stepped down as Glossier’s CEO and became executive chairwoman, with Kyle Leahy taking over as CEO.
